word_translation_en: to talk; to speak
sentence_example: Wir müssen über deine Zukunft reden.
sentence_example_translation_en: We need to talk about your future.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Нам нужно поговорить о твоем будущем.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen über deine Zukunft sprechen.
typical_collocations: über jemanden oder etwas reden; mit jemandem reden; Klartext reden; gut reden
usage_comments_en: 'reden' is slightly more informal than 'sprechen' and focuses on the act of talking or having a conversation. It governs with 'mit' (dative) and 'über' (accusative) or 'von' (dative).

word_translation_en: to address; to speak to
sentence_example: Wie soll ich den Chef anreden?
sentence_example_translation_en: How should I address the boss?
sentence_example_translation_ru: Как мне обращаться к боссу?
sentence_synonym: Wie soll ich den Chef ansprechen?
typical_collocations: jemanden höflich anreden; jemanden mit Sie anreden; jemanden mit dem Vornamen anreden
usage_comments_en: 'anreden' means to address someone in a specific way (e.g., using 'Sie' or 'Du', or a specific title). It takes a direct accusative object and is often used in formal or linguistic contexts.

word_translation_en: to finish speaking; to talk someone out of something
word_translation_ru: высказаться; договорить; отговорить кого-либо от чего-либо
sentence_example: Bitte lass mich zuerst ausreden!
sentence_example_translation_en: Please let me finish speaking first!
sentence_example_translation_ru: Пожалуйста, дай мне сначала высказаться!
sentence_synonym: Bitte lass mich zuerst aussprechen!
typical_collocations: jemanden ausreden lassen; sich eine Idee ausreden; jemandem etwas ausreden
usage_comments_en: 'ausreden' can be intransitive meaning 'to finish speaking' (often in imperative: 'Lass mich ausreden!'). It can also be transitive 'jemandem etwas ausreden' (to talk someone out of something), requiring Dative (person) and Accusative (thing).

word_translation_en: to ventriloquize; to speak from the stomach
sentence_example: Der Puppenspieler kann perfekt bauchreden.
sentence_example_translation_en: The puppeteer can ventriloquize perfectly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Кукольник отлично умеет чревовещать.
sentence_synonym: Der Puppenspieler kann perfekt mit dem Bauch sprechen.
typical_collocations: perfekt bauchreden; als Bauchredner auftreten
usage_comments_en: A rare and specific verb. Usually, the noun 'Bauchredner' (ventriloquist) or the description 'mit dem Bauch sprechen' is more common in modern everyday German.

word_translation_en: to discuss; to talk over
sentence_example: Wir müssen das Problem morgen bereden.
sentence_example_translation_en: We need to discuss the problem tomorrow.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Нам нужно обсудить эту проблему завтра.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen das Problem morgen besprechen.
typical_collocations: ein Problem bereden; Angelegenheiten bereden; alles in Ruhe bereden
usage_comments_en: 'bereden' is a synonym of 'besprechen', meaning to discuss a topic thoroughly. It is slightly more informal or regional than 'besprechen' and takes a direct accusative object.

word_translation_en: to babble; to talk nonsense; to talk foolishly
sentence_example: Er weiß nichts und redet nur dumm daher.
sentence_example_translation_en: He knows nothing and just talks foolishly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он ничего не знает и просто несёт глупый вздор.
sentence_synonym: Er weiß nichts und faselt nur dumm herum.
typical_collocations: dumm daherreden; wirres Zeug daherreden; ohne Sinn daherreden
usage_comments_en: Often used with 'dumm', 'wirr', or 'blöd'. It has a strong negative, pejorative connotation, implying that the speaker is talking without thinking or without substance. It is a separable verb.

word_translation_en: to talk aimlessly; to talk without reflection
sentence_example: Er redete ohne Konzept einfach so vor sich hin und dahin.
sentence_example_translation_en: Without a plan, he just talked aimlessly to himself.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Без какого-либо плана он просто болтал попусту.
sentence_synonym: Er schwatze ohne Konzept einfach so vor sich hin.
typical_collocations: vor sich hin dahinreden; ohne nachzudenken dahinreden
usage_comments_en: Rather rare in modern usage. It usually describes talking continuously without paying attention to the reaction of others or without a specific goal. Separable.

word_translation_en: to talk all at once; to talk in a confused manner
sentence_example: Alle Kinder wollten gleichzeitig antworten und redeten durcheinander.
sentence_example_translation_en: All the children wanted to answer at the same time and talked all at once.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Все дети хотели ответить одновременно и говорили наперебой.
sentence_synonym: Alle Kinder wollten gleichzeitig antworten und sprachen durcheinander.
typical_collocations: wild durcheinanderreden; alle redeten durcheinander
usage_comments_en: A combination of 'durcheinander' and 'reden'. It is used when multiple people talk at the same time, making it hard to understand anyone, or when one person talks in a chaotic, unstructured way. Separable.

word_translation_en: to persuade; to convince (of something false); to drill into
sentence_example: Du darfst dir nicht einreden, dass du schuld bist.
sentence_example_translation_en: You must not convince yourself that you are to blame.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ты не должен внушать себе, что виноват.
sentence_synonym: Du darfst dir nicht einbilden, dass du schuld bist.
typical_collocations: jemandem Schuldgefühle einreden; sich Mut einreden; jemandem etwas einreden
usage_comments_en: Commonly used reflexively ('sich [Dativ] etwas einreden') meaning 'to convince oneself of something'. Non-reflexively, it means to persuade someone else, often negatively (e.g., to talk them into believing a lie). Separable.

word_translation_en: to commit oneself in speech; to get bogged down in talking
word_translation_ru: заговориться; запутаться в своих словах; увлечься речью
sentence_example: Der Politiker hat sich bei der Debatte völlig festgeredet.
sentence_example_translation_en: The politician got completely bogged down during the debate.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Политик полностью запутался в своих словах во время дебатов.
sentence_synonym: Der Politiker hat sich bei der Debatte völlig festgequatscht.
typical_collocations: sich in Ausreden festreden; sich völlig festreden
usage_comments_en: Usually used reflexively ('sich festreden') to describe when someone speaks so much or so stubbornly on a point that they lose their way, make mistakes, or cannot change their position anymore. Separable.

word_translation_en: to play down; to downplay; to trivialize
sentence_example: Wir sollten den Erfolg unserer Konkurrenz nicht kleinreden.
sentence_example_translation_en: We should not play down the success of our competition.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Нам не следует преуменьшать успех наших конкурентов.
sentence_synonym: Wir sollten den Erfolg unserer Konkurrenz nicht herunterspielen.
typical_collocations: Probleme kleinreden; den Erfolg kleinreden; die Gefahren kleinreden
usage_comments_en: Highly common in media and politics. It means to talk about something (an achievement, a danger, or a crisis) in a way that makes it seem less important or significant than it actually is. Separable.

word_translation_en: to have a say; to join in the conversation
word_translation_ru: иметь право голоса; участвовать в разговоре
sentence_example: Bei diesem Thema kann ich leider nicht mitreden.
sentence_example_translation_en: Unfortunately, I cannot join the conversation on this topic.
sentence_example_translation_ru: К сожалению, я не могу ничего сказать по этой теме.
sentence_synonym: Bei diesem Thema kann ich mich leider nicht beteiligen.
typical_collocations: ein Wort mitreden; überall mitreden wollen; kompetent mitreden
usage_comments_en: Often used in the context of having the competence or the legal/social right to participate in a decision or discussion. Usually used with the preposition 'bei' (+ dative). Separable.

word_translation_en: to repeat (someone's words); to gossip about someone
word_translation_ru: повторять вслед за кем-то; сплетничать; злословить
sentence_example: Du solltest nicht alles unüberlegt nachreden.
sentence_example_translation_en: You shouldn't repeat everything without thinking.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Тебе не следует бездумно повторять всё подряд.
sentence_synonym: Du solltest nicht alles unüberlegt nachsprechen.
typical_collocations: jemandem Schlechtes nachreden; Worte nachreden; blind nachreden
usage_comments_en: Has two meanings: 1) To repeat words after someone (often mechanically like a parrot). 2) 'jemandem etwas (Böses/Schlechtes) nachreden' meaning to gossip or speak ill of someone behind their back. Separable.

word_translation_en: to badmouth; to criticize; to speak ill of
sentence_example: Warum musst du immer meine Ideen schlechtreden?
sentence_example_translation_en: Why do you always have to badmouth my ideas?
sentence_example_translation_ru: Почему ты всегда должен очернять мои идеи?
sentence_synonym: Warum musst du immer meine Ideen madigmachen?
typical_collocations: alles schlechtreden; Projekte schlechtreden; die Leistung schlechtreden
usage_comments_en: 'schlechtreden' means to present something in a bad light, often unfairly. Similar to 'kleinreden', but with a focus on active negativity and finding faults rather than just downplaying size or importance. Separable.

word_translation_en: to sugarcoat; to gloss over; to beautify with words
sentence_example: Man darf die schlechte wirtschaftliche Lage nicht schönreden.
sentence_example_translation_en: One must not sugarcoat the bad economic situation.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Нельзя приукрашивать плохое экономическое положение.
sentence_synonym: Man darf die schlechte wirtschaftliche Lage nicht beschönigen.
typical_collocations: die Situation schönreden; Probleme schönreden; sich die Realität schönreden
usage_comments_en: The direct opposite of 'schlechtreden'. It means to make a bad situation, decision, or fact look good or harmless through talk. Very common in political discussions. Separable.

word_translation_en: to persuade; to talk into
sentence_example: Sie konnte ihn schließlich überreden, mitzukommen.
sentence_example_translation_en: She finally managed to persuade him to come along.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ей наконец удалось уговорить его пойти вместе.
sentence_synonym: Sie konnte ihn schließlich überzeugen, mitzukommen.
typical_collocations: jemanden zu einer Reise überreden; sich leicht überreden lassen
usage_comments_en: 'überreden' focuses on getting someone to do something they initially didn't want to, using persistence or charm (unlike 'überzeugen', which relies on facts). Takes direct accusative object and 'zu' (+ dative). Inseparable.

word_translation_en: to converse; to confer; to discuss
sentence_example: Die Minister unterredeten sich über die neuen Gesetze.
sentence_example_translation_en: The ministers conferred on the new laws.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Министры совещались по поводу новых законов.
sentence_synonym: Die Minister besprachen sich über die neuen Gesetze.
typical_collocations: sich mit jemandem unterreden; sich über die Lage unterreden
usage_comments_en: Used almost exclusively in the reflexive form 'sich unterreden mit/über'. It is highly formal, elevated, or literary, describing a serious discussion or negotiation. Inseparable.

word_translation_en: to arrange; to make an appointment; to agree on
sentence_example: Wir haben uns für morgen Nachmittag verabredet.
sentence_example_translation_en: We have made plans to meet tomorrow afternoon.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы договорились встретиться завтра после обеда.
sentence_synonym: Wir haben für morgen Nachmittag ein Treffen vereinbart.
typical_collocations: einen Termin verabreden; sich mit Freunden verabreden; ein Treffen verabreden
usage_comments_en: Commonly used reflexively ('sich verabreden mit' + dative) meaning to make a social date. Can also be transitive: 'einen Ort/Termin verabreden' (to agree on a place/date). Inseparable.

word_translation_en: to talk past each other; to miss the point
word_translation_ru: говорить на разных языках; говорить мимо темы
sentence_example: Wir reden völlig aneinander vorbei.
sentence_example_translation_en: We are talking completely past each other.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы говорим совершенно на разных языках (не понимая друг друга).
sentence_synonym: Wir missverstehen uns völlig.
typical_collocations: aneinander vorbeireden; am Thema vorbeireden
usage_comments_en: Most commonly used in the fixed expression 'aneinander vorbeireden' (to talk past each other). It can also mean 'am Thema vorbeireden' (to talk about things irrelevant to the main topic). Separable.

word_translation_en: to talk away; to explain away; to dismiss with words
sentence_example: Die Krise lässt sich nicht einfach wegreden.
sentence_example_translation_en: The crisis cannot simply be explained away.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Эту кризисную ситуацию нельзя просто замять разговорами.
sentence_synonym: Die Krise lässt sich nicht einfach wegerklären.
typical_collocations: Probleme wegreden; Tatsachen wegreden wollen; Schmerzen wegreden
usage_comments_en: To try to make a problem, fact, or feeling disappear or seem nonexistent merely by talking about it or dismissing it. Often used in passive constructions or with 'lassen'. Separable.

word_translation_en: to talk on; to keep talking; to continue speaking
sentence_example: Bitte reden Sie weiter, ich höre Ihnen zu.
sentence_example_translation_en: Please go on speaking, I am listening to you.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Пожалуйста, продолжайте говорить, я вас слушаю.
sentence_synonym: Bitte fahren Sie fort, ich höre Ihnen zu.
typical_collocations: einfach weiterreden; stundenlang weiterreden
usage_comments_en: A simple combination of 'weiter' and 'reden'. It means to continue a speech, monologue, or conversation that was interrupted. Separable.

word_translation_en: to analyze to death; to talk something to pieces; to ruin by over-discussing
sentence_example: Wir sollten diese gute Idee nicht durch zu lange Debatten zerreden.
sentence_example_translation_en: We shouldn't talk this good idea to death with excessively long debates.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Нам не следует губить эту хорошую идею бесконечными дебатами.
sentence_synonym: Wir sollten diese gute Idee nicht durch zu lange Debatten totdiskutieren.
typical_collocations: Entwürfe zerreden; Pläne zerreden; alles zerreden
usage_comments_en: A very typical German concept. It means to talk so much and so critically about a plan or idea that the initial enthusiasm is completely lost or the project gets bogged down in endless discussions. Inseparable.

word_translation_en: to encourage; to urge; to speak encouragingly
sentence_example: Er wollte erst nicht springen, aber wir haben ihm gut zugeredet.
sentence_example_translation_en: He didn't want to jump at first, but we encouraged him.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Сначала он не хотел прыгать, но мы его подбодрили.
sentence_synonym: Er wollte erst nicht springen, aber wir haben ihm gut zugesprochen.
typical_collocations: jemandem gut zureden; sanft zureden; eindringlich zureden
usage_comments_en: 'zureden' usually requires the adverb 'gut' ('jemandem gut zureden') and means to speak encouragingly or persuasively but kindly to someone. It governs the dative case. Separable.
